owner_request: 2026-10-18, in chat: 'say ... the US is banning oil imports and only allows this specific US oil company to sell, then wouldnt it make sense that if we hear about that, it would make sense to invest in that company ... you could choose how to incorporate and run this whole idea'
why_this_exists: The owner's idea in its general form: when company-specific news arrives, buy the company and ride it. Chan (JFE 2003, abstract read 2026-10-18) finds prices DRIFT after news headlines (most strongly after bad news) and REVERSE after extreme moves with no news, mainly in small illiquid stocks. A24 and A28 separated results days from everything else; they never separated company news from no news. EDGAR 8-K filings give a free, timestamped, point-in-time record of company news: material agreements (1.01), acquisitions (2.01), Regulation FD and other events (7.01, 8.01).

data.filings: every 8-K and 8-K/A in the EDGAR submissions files already cached for the 1,057 issuers ever in the top 500 by liquidity (data/sec_historical_identity_cache, Step 364), 2011-10 onward
data.not_news_items_for_this_test: 2.02 (results; A28 covered those) and 5.02/5.07 (officer changes, shareholder votes) on their own
data.reaction_day: A28's rule: the first trading day whose close follows the acceptance time

events.universe: each day, the 500 most liquid stocks (A24/A28)
events.move: one-day return minus the equal-weight liquid-universe return >= +10% (up) or <= -10% (down)
events.news_up: an up move whose reaction day carries a news-item 8-K filed by the same company, and no 2.02
events.no_news_up: an up move with NO 8-K of any kind on the reaction day or the trading day before it

trials.T1_news_up_126d: buy news_up stocks at the close of the day after the move, hold 126 trading days, minus 50 random same-SIC2 liquid controls (A24). Declared POSITIVE (news drift).
trials.T2_no_news_up_126d: the same for no_news_up. Declared NEGATIVE (reversal). Long-only: a pass would be an AVOID rule, not a short.

diagnostics_not_verdicts: news_down and no_news_down (Chan's strongest drift is after bad news; long-only use would be avoidance only)
significance: event-level outcomes, block bootstrap over event months (block 3), 4000 draws, two-sided
pass_rule: T1: design mean > 0 with p < 0.025, holdout mean > 0, survives dropping the top 10 events, design mean > 50 bps. T2: the same with signs reversed.
contamination_declared: A24/A28 printed 'non-results jumps' (news and no-news combined) at -3.83% (63d) and -4.50% (126d) in 2012-2018. The split by news has not been seen.
known_weaknesses_declared_up_front: An 8-K is company news, not all news: an external event (a ban, a tariff) moves a stock without the company filing anything, and lands in 'no news'.
Large, liquid stocks only (top 500); Chan's effects are strongest in small, illiquid ones.
Survivorship in the price panel as A19.
